_: THE RECORD OF STANDING — the one place the College's own figures live.
Every page that states what WEC-LC has actually done reads from this
file. Nothing is typed twice, so nothing can drift: the Arabic edition
and the English edition cannot disagree, and a figure corrected here is
corrected on every page in both languages by re-running the build.
THE RULE THAT MAKES IT SAFE. A count left null is not a zero and not a
placeholder — it means the College has the record but has not released
the figure for publication. Where a count is null the build emits the
unnumbered wording held in `prose`, and tests/published-claims.test.mjs
fails the build if a numeral appears in copy that this file has not
supplied. That is deliberate. It means the achievement can be published
today at exactly the level the College can evidence, and the exact
figures become a one-line edit here rather than a rewrite of 56 pages.
TO PUBLISH A FIGURE: replace the null with the integer from the
enrolment register, set `released` to the date it was checked against
that register, and run `node scripts/build.js`. Do not put a number
here that a transcript could not be produced for.

_: The chronology that resolves what would otherwise be a contradiction.
The College taught and conferred from 2023 under its own academic
authority. The governance instrument adopted on 14 August 2026 created
the office of Independent External Examiner and bound every award made
under it to that office's moderation. That office is empty. So the
awards conferred to date are internally moderated, the instrument
binds awards from its adoption forward, and both statements are true
at once. The site says which is which rather than choosing one.
